SELECT DR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, DR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, DR.REVIEW_TYPE AS reviewType, DR.TARGET_ID AS targetId, DR.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, DR.REQUEST_REASON AS requestReason, DR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, DR.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, DR.REQ_DATE AS reqDate, DR.ADMIN_NO AS adminNo, DR.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate, COALESCE(H.NAME, S.NAME) AS hospitalName, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent, M.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, R.REG_DATE AS reviewRegDate, 'DELETE_REQ' AS sourceCd FROM TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST DR LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = DR.REVIEW_TYPE LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL H ON H.HOSPITAL_ID = DR.TARGET_ID AND DR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = DR.TARGET_ID AND DR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'STAY' JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = DR.BIZ_NO WHERE DR.REVIEW_TYPE IN ('HOSPITAL', 'STAY')
UNION ALL
SELECT RR.REPORT_ID AS requestId, RR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, 'PRODUCT' AS reviewType, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, RR.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, RR.REASON AS requestReason, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(500)) AS rejectReason, CASE WHEN RR.STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN RR.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' AND RR.REVIEW_ID IS NULL THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN RR.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE RR.STATUS_CD END AS statusCd, RR.REG_DATE AS reqDate, RR.ADMIN_NO AS adminNo, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS processDate, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS hospitalName, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent, M.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, R.REG_DATE AS reviewRegDate, 'REPORT' AS sourceCd FROM TB_REVIEW_REPORT RR LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_ID = RR.REVIEW_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.TARGET_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = RR.BIZ_NO WHERE RR.REPORTER_TYPE = 'BIZ'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST WHERE STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' AND REVIEW_TYPE IN ('HOSPITAL', 'STAY')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW_REPORT WHERE REPORTER_TYPE = 'BIZ' AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING') FROM DUAL

SELECT DR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, DR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, DR.REVIEW_TYPE AS reviewType, DR.TARGET_ID AS targetId, DR.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, DR.REQUEST_REASON AS requestReason, DR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, DR.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, DR.REQ_DATE AS reqDate, DR.ADMIN_NO AS adminNo, DR.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate, COALESCE(H.NAME, S.NAME) AS hospitalName, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent, M.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, R.REG_DATE AS reviewRegDate, 'DELETE_REQ' AS sourceCd FROM TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST DR LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = DR.REVIEW_TYPE LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL H ON H.HOSPITAL_ID = DR.TARGET_ID AND DR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = DR.TARGET_ID AND DR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'STAY' JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = DR.BIZ_NO WHERE DR.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}

SELECT RR.REPORT_ID AS requestId, RR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, 'PRODUCT' AS reviewType, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, RR.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, RR.REASON AS requestReason, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(500)) AS rejectReason, CASE WHEN RR.STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN RR.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' AND RR.REVIEW_ID IS NULL THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN RR.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE RR.STATUS_CD END AS statusCd, RR.REG_DATE AS reqDate, RR.ADMIN_NO AS adminNo, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS processDate, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS hospitalName, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent, M.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, R.REG_DATE AS reviewRegDate, 'REPORT' AS sourceCd FROM TB_REVIEW_REPORT RR LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_ID = RR.REVIEW_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.TARGET_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = RR.BIZ_NO WHERE RR.REPORT_ID = #{reportId} AND RR.REPORTER_TYPE = 'BIZ'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED', ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo}, PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'

UPDATE TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo}, PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
